# AvatarGroup

A few people at once, such as who shares a joint account or a split bill.

## When to use

- Showing that several people are involved, in a row or a card.

## When not to use

- A list people choose from: use RecipientRow.

## Behavior and responsive

- Shows up to `max` avatars (default 3) and a "+n" counter for the rest.

## Do

- Put the most relevant people first.

## Don't

- Do not use it as a button without a visible label next to it.

## Accessibility

- One image named with the people it shows: "Deniz Yılmaz, Ece Kaya and 2 more".

## Example

```tsx
import { AvatarGroup } from "@leeward/react";

export function JointAccount() {
  return <AvatarGroup people={[{ name: "Deniz Yılmaz" }, { name: "Ece Kaya" }, { name: "Can Öztürk" }, { name: "Elif Şahin" }]} max={3} />;
}
```
